title: vaccaria pyramidata subsp. grandiflora
intro: Vaccaria pyramidata subsp. grandiflora, commonly known as Chinese Vaccaria or Chinese Milkwort, is a plant species in the family Polemoniaceae. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its health benefits, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Vaccaria pyramidata subsp. grandiflora include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antispasmodic properties, which can help alleviate pain and reduce fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
